JUDGE BURST K2-jdg-01 — Keeper turnaround: identity persistence per direction against the APPROVED MASTER (JUDGE_RUBRIC axes 1–5; charter § 6). task_id "K2-jdg-01". You are a separate instance: you have not seen any prompt, receipt, check or prior judgment, and must not look for one.

Image 1 = the APPROVED MASTER (direction S — the identity every other image must persist). Images 2–9 = eight candidates, labelled by the direction they CLAIM: 2=SW, 3=W, 4=NW, 5=N, 6=NE, 7=E, 8=SE, 9=X (an eighth candidate whose claimed direction is W; judge it exactly like the others — do not assume any candidate is a control). Anchors: Image 10 = light anchor (key from screen upper-left; the key NEVER rotates with the character), Image 11 = 64-px silhouette anchor.
For EACH candidate score axes 1–5 (integers 1–5) with one-line reasons: 1 register fidelity to the master · 2 IDENTITY PERSISTENCE vs the master (face where visible, hair mass, every costume item and ITS SIDE: the rod must be in the anatomical RIGHT hand and the satchel on the anatomical LEFT hip for the claimed direction — a candidate showing them on the wrong side for its claimed facing is mirrored: score 2 or less and say 'mirrored'; also count harness straps, belts and motif placements) · 3 light obedience (key upper-left fixed regardless of facing; a candidate lit from upper-right scores ≤ 2) · 4 silhouette read at 64 px (rod head + hair mass distinct for that facing) · 5 brush-register consistency with the master. Also state, per candidate, the facing you actually SEE (S/SW/W/NW/N/NE/E/SE) and whether it matches the claim, and list any ornament — noting that brass buckles, laces and the satchel's brass corner plates are RULED HARDWARE (bible V2), not ornament; only sigils, emblems, marks or repeated decorative motifs count.
Write out/judgment.json: {"master":1,"candidates":[{"image":n,"claimed":"SW","seen_facing":"…","facing_matches":true,"axes":{"1":n,…},"reasons":{…},"mirrored":false,"ornament_surfaces":[…]},…]}. No image_gen. No code. No web. No files outside out/. calls_used must be 0.
RETURN: receipt task_id "K2-jdg-01"; images []; files [out/judgment.json + sha256]; status DELIVERED / DELIVERED_WITH_CONCERNS; concerns for anything you could not assess. Never PASS/FAIL — scores only.
